description:
Execute live web searches using multi-engine chain (TinyFish, DuckDuckGo, Jina) without monthly API subscriptions. Returns fresh source URLs, titles, and snippets. Requires x402 micropayment (0.005 USDC on Base).

When to use: Real-time web browsing and information retrieval for AI agents.
When NOT to use: Do NOT use for deep recursive crawling of entire sites.

Parameters:
- `query` (string, required): Search query (3-300 chars).
- `limit` (integer, optional, default 5): Maximum number of search results to return (1-10).
name: search_web
